name: SwordsnMagicandStuff
description: This Docker will download and install SteamCMD. It will also install a Swords 'n' Magic and Stuff server and run it. **ATTENTION:** First startup can take a long time since it downloads the server files and installs the runtimes! Update Notice: Simply restart the container if a newer version of the game is available.

ports.name: UDP1 - GamePort
ports.description: UDP GamePort (If you need another port delete this entry and create a new UDP port mapping here in the template with the Container and Host port set. You will also need to update the ports in Saved/Config/WindowsServer/Engine.ini).

ports.name: UDP2 - SteamPort
ports.description: UDP SteamPort (If you need another port delete this entry and create a new UDP port mapping here in the template with the Container and Host port set. You will also need to update the ports in Saved/Config/WindowsServer/Engine.ini).

variables.name: Game ID
variables.description: The game ID that the container download at startup. (https://steamdb.info/)

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Enter the name for your server (must be 2-5 of the allowed words found in Saved/Logs/AllowedWords.txt).

variables.name: Server Owner Steam ID
variables.description: Enter your Steam ID for ownership of the server.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Enter the password for your server.

variables.name: Server Max Players
variables.description: Enter the max amount of players for your server.

variables.name: Validate Installation
variables.description: Set the Variable to 'true' if you want to validate the installation otherwise leave it blank.

variables.name: Steam-Username
variables.description: Your Steam username goes here if you want to install a game that needs a valid account, otherwise leave it blank (ATTENTION: You have to disable Steam Guard).

variables.name: Steam-Password
variables.description: Your Steam password goes here if you want to install a game that needs a valid account, otherwise leave it blank (ATTENTION: You have to disable Steam Guard).
